reuse.why: Adds a small visibleCategoriesFilter SQL fragment shared by the five query-based actions, but builds on five copies of the same category SELECT rather than one query helper, and copyPreviousMonth's in-JS hidden check is not routed through it.

duplication.why: The flag is threaded into five copies of an identical SELECT, and the hidden rule now exists both as the SQL fragment and as copyPreviousMonth's own hidden/group_hidden test.

placement.why: The option type and filter fragment live in budget/actions.ts next to the actions, consistent with the tree.

scope.why: Only the flag, its use in the actions and one test.

maintainability.why: The hidden rule is decided in two different forms (string-interpolated SQL fragment and a JS check), and copyPreviousMonth, a month-wide action, silently ignores the new flag.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth keeps its own prevBudget.hidden/group_hidden check and does not take includeHiddenCategories or the new filter.

disguised_duplication.where: The hidden-category rule appears as a SQL WHERE fragment (visibleCategoriesFilter) in five queries and as a JS condition in copyPreviousMonth: the same rule in reshaped form rather than one definition.
